## v0.1.0-beta.3 - 2026-04-12

### 🔧 其他

- Redesign FakePlayer list items with vanilla dark panel style

- Dark panel background per item (alternating rows, hover, selected)
- Left 3px green accent bar for selected item
- Transparent click targets; all visuals rendered manually
- Player name drawn inline with dynamic truncation for timer overlap
- Pending spawn: bordered green icon; pending kill: red corner dot
- Remove top hint/selected text; extend FakePlayer area from tabBarBottom+4
- PLAYER_ITEM_HEIGHT=26, ITEM_GAP=0 for denser cleaner layout
- Scrollbar now 3px wide, positioned closer to list edge

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
- Use vanilla button sprites for FakePlayer list

- Player list items use widget/button and widget/button_highlighted sprites
- Selected: widget/button_highlighted plus subtle green tint overlay
- Pending spawn: spectator/teleport_to_player sprite as face icon
- Pending task indicator: player_list/remove_player sprite in face corner
- Offline player: grey placeholder
- Name colors: white when selected, light grey otherwise
- Removed dark custom panel and accent bar

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
- Add clock icon, full-face overlay, timed spawn coords

- Custom 8x8 clock sprite rendered before timer text in player list
- Pending task indicator covers full face with red overlay + remove icon centered
- Timed spawn: toggle between current position and custom X/Y/Z coordinates
- Custom coords pre-filled with current player position on screen open
- TimedTaskManager: spawn command uses 'spawn at X Y Z' when custom coords set
- New lang keys: fakeplayer.timed.spawn.pos.current / .custom (en+zh)

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
- Use vanilla MC clock icon, optimize batch spawn layout, center dialogs

Clock icon:
- Replaced custom 8x8 clock sprite with vanilla MC clock_00 (16x16)
- Render clock icon at 10x10 in player list rows for better clarity

BatchSpawnScreen:
- Type toggle now calls rebuildWidgets(), compacting layout for English mode
  (removes blank space reserved for hidden Prefix/Start fields)
- Content vertically centered per screen height with slight upward bias
- Removed stale typeButton field; mode state preserved across rebuilds

TimedSpawnSetupScreen:
- Layout anchored via computeTitleY() = max(15, (height-205)/2 - 10)
  so content is well-centered with slight upward bias on any screen size
- Replaces hardcoded centerY offsets; all positions derive from titleY

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
- Update license to GPL v3

### 🔨 代码重构

- Extract base classes and fix critical bugs
- Active-only widget registration and fix FakePlayer overflow

### 🚀 新功能

- Enhance custom category and UI improvements
- Improve timer UI, fix fakeplayer list, add button icons
